landing.tagline: Privacy-First — browsing data always stays on your device
landing.desc: EchoFocus automatically tracks your browsing, analyzes your work patterns, and delivers personalized productivity insights — helping you stay more focused every day.
landing.feature1Desc: Google Gemini AI analyzes your work patterns and gives specific, actionable improvement tips — like having a personal coach on standby.
landing.feature2Desc: Clear charts reveal daily and weekly trends, showing your most focused periods and the sites that distract you most.
landing.feature3Desc: All browsing history is stored entirely on your device — never uploaded to any server. Even AI analysis uses only anonymized aggregate data.
landing.privacyTitle: Privacy Protection Built Into the Architecture — Not Added as an Afterthought
landing.privacyDesc: Unlike RescueTime and Toggl Track, which send browsing data to their servers, EchoFocus uses a local-first architecture. Lawyers, doctors, engineers, and anyone handling sensitive information can use it with confidence.

privacy.coreCommitment: Your browsing history is your private data. EchoFocus uses a local-first architecture — all raw browsing data (URLs, page titles, time spent) is stored exclusively on your device and is never uploaded to any server.
